newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT jumps 5.36 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: PLDT jumps 5.36 pct in early trade.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co climbed 45 pesos, or 5.36 percent, to 885 pesos in early Thursday trade on positioning ahead of its second quarter earnings as well as a rise in its ADR in New York, brokers said.
"There was a big increase in PLDT's ADR in New York and people may be buying in anticipation of a further increase," said Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities.
Anscor-Hagedorn Securities analyst Elline Salvatierra said investors were taking an interest in PLDT ahead of the firm's second quarter earnings.
